import mill.*, scalalib.*, scalajslib.*
import mill.scalajslib.api.ModuleKind
import mill.api.Task.Simple
import os.Path

object versions:
  def scala = "3.7.3"
  def scalaJS = "1.20.1"
  def dom     = "2.8.1"

object common extends ScalaModule:
  def scalaVersion = versions.scala

  def mvnDeps = Seq(
    mvn"com.lihaoyi::upickle::4.3.2"
  )

  object js extends ScalaJSModule:
    def scalaVersion = versions.scala
    def scalaJSVersion = versions.scalaJS

    def moduleDir: Path = common.moduleDir
    def mvnDeps = common.mvnDeps


object bluetooth extends ScalaJSModule:
  def scalaVersion   = versions.scala
  def scalaJSVersion = versions.scalaJS
  def moduleDeps     = Seq(common.js)
  def moduleKind     = ModuleKind.ESModule
  def mvnDeps = Seq(
    mvn"org.scala-js::scalajs-dom::${versions.dom}" // Web Bluetooth via `navigator.bluetooth`
  )



object server extends ScalaModule:
  def scalaVersion = versions.scala

  def moduleDeps = Seq(common)

  def mvnDeps = Seq( 
    mvn"com.lihaoyi::cask:0.10.2",
    mvn"com.lihaoyi::os-lib:0.11.5",
   
  )

  def resources = Task(
    super.resources()
    ++ client.resources()
    :+ client.fullLinkJS().dest
  )

object client extends ScalaJSModule:
  def scalaVersion   = versions.scala
  def scalaJSVersion = versions.scalaJS

  def moduleDeps = Seq(common.js)

  def mvnDeps = Seq(
    mvn"io.indigoengine::tyrian::0.14.0",
    mvn"io.indigoengine::tyrian-io::0.14.0"
  )

  def moduleKind = ModuleKind.ESModule
